# daroms-speed-site

> A Next.js framework and Claude Code workflow that turns a brief into a varied, production-grade website at low token cost.

## Docs

- [daroms-speed-site](https://github.com/daromsartof/daroms-speed-site/blob/main/docs/index.md): A Next.js framework and Claude Code workflow that turns a brief into a varied, production-grade website at low token cost.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/daromsartof/daroms-speed-site/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): Create a site with one command, open it in Claude Code, and let the /dss-site skill take it from brief to deploy.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/daromsartof/daroms-speed-site/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Versioned infrastructure in core packages, owned visual code in the site, data files the CLI rewrites, generated files nobody edits.
- [Design DNA](https://github.com/daromsartof/daroms-speed-site/blob/main/docs/design-dna.md): Each site rolls a deterministic, accessible design identity that avoids the combinations of recent sites and the usual generated-site tells.
- [AI layer](https://github.com/daromsartof/daroms-speed-site/blob/main/docs/ai-layer.md): How dss keeps Claude Code fast and cheap: small always-on context, rules by path, forked workers, guard hooks, a router and a shared brain.
- [Modules and data](https://github.com/daromsartof/daroms-speed-site/blob/main/docs/modules.md): Optional features install site-owned code, environment documentation, CSP sources and manifest entries, and plug into generated slots.
- [Deploy, security and SEO](https://github.com/daromsartof/daroms-speed-site/blob/main/docs/deploy.md): Static by default, secure headers and CSP from the manifest, previews never indexed, one command per target.
- [Visual edits with AimKit](https://github.com/daromsartof/daroms-speed-site/blob/main/docs/aimkit.md): Pick an element in the browser, type the change, and Claude Code opens the exact file and line.
- [Factory: brain, sites, batch, upgrades](https://github.com/daromsartof/daroms-speed-site/blob/main/docs/factory.md): What makes dss a production line: a memory shared by all sites, a registry, batch creation, upgrades and releases.
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/daromsartof/daroms-speed-site/blob/main/docs/cli.md): Every dss command, generated from the CLI itself. In a site run them as `pnpm dss <command>`.

## Catalog

- [CATALOG.md](https://github.com/daromsartof/daroms-speed-site/blob/main/CATALOG.md): tokens, components, sections, modules, archetypes, font pairs, package APIs
